entities.summary: Afanasy Lavrentievich Ordin-Nashchokin was a Russian statesman. He was a diak of the posolsky prikaz. He was the first junior noble to attain the boyar title and highest offices of state not as a result of family connections but due to his personal capabilities and achievements.
